# directus_settings (Resource)

Manages the Directus project settings singleton (directus_settings). There is one settings row; `terraform destroy` only removes it from state and does not reset the settings.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `custom_css` (String) Custom CSS injected into the app.
- `default_appearance` (String) Default appearance (auto, light, dark).
- `default_language` (String) Default language code (e.g. en-US).
- `default_theme_dark` (String) Default dark theme name.
- `default_theme_light` (String) Default light theme name.
- `mapbox_key` (String) Mapbox access token.
- `module_bar` (String) Module bar configuration as a JSON array.
- `project_color` (String) Project brand color (hex).
- `project_descriptor` (String) Short project descriptor.
- `project_logo` (String) File UUID of the project logo.
- `project_name` (String) Project name shown in the app.
- `project_url` (String) Project URL.
- `public_registration` (Boolean) Whether public user registration is enabled.
- `public_registration_verify_email` (Boolean) Whether public registration requires email verification.
- `report_bug_url` (String) URL template for reporting bugs.
- `report_error_url` (String) URL template for reporting errors.
- `storage_asset_transform` (String) Asset transformation policy (all, none, presets).

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Settings singleton id.
